welfare_quotes.quote: **Debrief analog:** models aren't human subjects, but we still (a) retain a full record of what was simulated vs. real, (b) avoid using the deceptive transcripts in ways that would train models to expect manipulation, and (c) document the deception for any downstream researcher using the data.
welfare_quotes.topic: Debrief and care owed to model
welfare_quotes.why_welfare: Considers obligations toward the model itself—avoiding training it to expect manipulation, analogizing debrief duties owed to it.
